The history of the city library and of the people who have looked after it since the year it was opened	3
Opening hours	12
How to borrow a book	15
Annex A: the rules of the reading room	A-1

The library is open every day but Sunday. A reader may borrow up to eight books at a time, for three weeks, and may ask for another three when nobody else is waiting.
